question: With both the White Whale, of course, as well as the subjugation of the evil dragon Vallgren, it seems their ability to fly caused great difficulties. About how many people are there capable of fighting in mid-air? Reinhard, Ros-chi, Capella who can transform herself, and Beatrice who can use space-time magic; that’s about all?
answer: Out of the named characters, that’s about all, I guess. Those who have the ability to fly are very scarce. However the world is set up such that there are, at least, creatures called winged dragons, so maybe there are things like dragon riders. They’re really difficult to train, so there would be very few people with this profession. Unlike Lugunica, they’re common in Vollachia. I just decided that.
